article.title: Russian attacks kill 12, injure 82 across Ukraine over past day as country reels from mass overnight strike
article.summary: Overnight on Nov. 20, Russia launched 84 cruise missiles and 404 drones, as well as Iskander-M/S-400 ballistic missiles and Zircon hypersonic anti-ship missiles. Ukraine's Air Force did not disclose the total number of the latter missiles.

article.title: Ukrainian air defence brought down 462 assets during massive Russian attack

article.summary: Ukraine’s strikes on the Crimean railway bridge and Russia’s refineries are no longer just symbolic blows, but a coordinated effort to choke off fuel, supplies, and troop movements deep inside Russian-held territory.

article.title: Three Kyiv bridges hit during major Russian missile attack

article.summary: The Kerch Bridge is a key artery for military and civilian supplies to Crimea, which Moscow seized in defiance of international law in 2014.

article.title: Ukraine Hits Back: 3 Russian Missile Launchers Targeted Overnight

article.title: Ukraine: Kyiv metro stations become overnight shelters amid air raids

This week, the Ukrainians finally finished the job.
